journal_lines: The silence changed quality. Came back without something. Won't say why.
Something down there. Left quickly. Left something behind.
The deep took something. Trade seems fair given what was not taken.
Left something in the deep. Not sure what. Lighter going back.
Something answered from the dark. Came back without the last find.
The deep doesn't keep what you're not ready to leave. Left something.
A fair trade, if unfair trades can be called fair. Left. Came back.
The sound returned what the silence demanded. Dropped it. Left quickly.
Not every find survives the trip back. This was one of those.
The deep has preferences. I have fewer. We reached an understanding.
Came back lighter. Not lighter than I went in. Lighter than I was at the end.
Whatever was listening, it kept the last thing. The other things came home.
